book_info.title: The Magic Garden
book_info.subtitle: Where Wonders Grow
book_info.moral: With care and patience, wonderful things can grow

art_style.lighting: warm golden sunlight filtering through leaves, dappled light
art_style.texture: rich watercolor with detailed botanical elements, soft edges, nature textures

maya.name: Maya
maya.description: A cheerful little girl with curly black hair in two puffs with colorful hair ties, warm brown skin, bright curious dark brown eyes, and a wide happy smile showing a small gap in her front teeth. Round cheeks.

clothing.gardening_outfit: Yellow sundress with green leaf pattern, small green rubber boots, and a floppy straw sun hat with a pink ribbon

maya.personality: curious, nurturing, patient, full of wonder
maya.accessories: A small red watering can she carries everywhere

grandma_rose.name: Grandma Rose
grandma_rose.description: A warm, plump elderly woman with silver-grey hair in a bun, warm brown skin with smile wrinkles, kind dark eyes behind round glasses, and a gentle smile. She wears a floral apron over a soft blue dress.
grandma_rose.personality: wise, patient, loving, knows all about plants

flutter.name: Flutter
flutter.description: A large, beautiful butterfly with iridescent wings that shimmer between purple, blue, and pink. Leaves tiny sparkles wherever it flies. Has friendly antenna that curl playfully.

settings.magic_garden: A lush, colorful garden overflowing with flowers of every color, winding stone paths, tall sunflowers, rose bushes, vegetable patches, and a small wooden bench. Butterflies and bees everywhere.
settings.greenhouse: A small glass greenhouse filled with seedlings in pots, gardening tools, and shelves of plants
settings.vegetable_patch: Rows of vegetables - tomatoes, carrots, pumpkins - with stakes and string, rich brown soil
